__title: Pricing: the report book stays free · MyWorkLog
__metaDescription: The MyWorkLog report book stays free: AI assistant, PDF in the IHK template, trainer sign-off. The training pass with what apprentices asked for in the survey is ready, buying it opens soon.
__ogDescription: The report book stays free. The pass is ready, buying it opens soon.
prLede.das_berichtsheft_bleibt_kostenlos: The report book stays free, with AI assistant, PDF in the IHK template and trainer sign-off. What you asked for in the survey is in the pass and has been built. Buying it opens as soon as payment is set up.

prWunschU.umfrage_unter_nutzern_oktober_: User survey, October 2026, 10 votes. Next to each wish: where it goes.
prF1.bleibt_das_kostenlose_berichtsheft_: Will the free report book stay free?
prF1.ja_das_berichtsheft_bleibt_fuer: Yes, the report book stays free forever: writing, saving, PDF in the IHK template, trainer sign-off. We cannot promise that for the AI. Every answer costs us money, and how much of it stays free depends on what it costs us.
prF3.was_passiert_beim_vormerken: What happens when I count myself in?
prF3.gezaehlt_wird_nur_wie_oft: Only the number of times a book was picked is counted. No name is stored, no account is created and no email address is asked for. Your device then shows “Noted” so you do not click twice.

prF4.wird_etwas_das_heute_kostenlos: Will something that is free today cost money later?
prF4.nein_in_pass_und_plus: No. Pass and Plus only get what does not exist yet. The one exception remains the size of the free AI allowance, because it depends on what the AI costs us.
prTabFuss.das_tageslimit_zaehlt_wie_heut: The daily limit counts the tokens used, just like today. Pass and Plus raise it to 5x; the AI never comes without any limit.
prHefteU.das_kostenlose_ist_offen_der: The free book is open, the pass is ready and on sale soon. You can put your name down for Plus: it counts as a vote for opening it.
prBaldU.fertig_gebaut_bezahlen_laesst_si: Fully built. Payment cannot be set up yet.
prVormerkHinweis.vormerken_zaehlt_nur_mi: Counting you in only records whether Plus is wanted. No name, no account, no email.
prTabU.der_pass_ist_fertig_plus: The pass is ready, Plus is still sealed. “New” means built, but only in the pass. “Planned” means it does not exist yet.
prF2.wann_kann_ich_den_pass: When can I buy the pass?
prF2.sobald_die_bezahlung_eingerichtet_i: As soon as payment is set up. The pass is ready and the prices are set, there is no date yet. Plus comes after that.
